model_name: improved unstructured model with sucrose hydrolysis
equations_quote: we used a second unstructured model (Eq. 2-3, 5-8, 18-20), accommodating the hydrolysis of sucrose into fructose and glucose (Eq. 18-20)
description: Unstructured segregated Monod-type model of tobacco BY-2 cell suspension cultures in a stirred-tank bioreactor (batch and fed-batch): active and dead dry mass, volume, sucrose hydrolysed to glucose and fructose, ammonium, nitrate and phosphate.

model_assumptions.text: The model assumes an irreversible progression in which active cells (active DM) are converted into dead cells (dead DM).
model_assumptions.quote: The model assumes an irreversible progression in which active cells (active DM) are converted into dead cells (dead DM) (Jacob et al., 2020) (Eq. 2).

review.note: LLM proposed two models (initial eqs 1-8, improved eqs 1-8 + 18-20) with invented boundary quotes (caught by the quote check). Kept the improved model only, as the paper states it: eqs 2-3, 5-8, 18-20 (eq 4 is replaced by eq 18; eq 1 X = Xa + Xd is not part of it). Kept the one quoted assumption (active to dead DM, eq 2); dropped three unquoted ones.

llm_proposal.name: initial unstructured segregated Monod-type model
llm_proposal.description: An unstructured segregated mechanistic model for tobacco BY‑2 cell suspension cultures in a stirred‑tank bioreactor operated in batch/fed‑batch mode, predicting active and dead dry mass, volume, and concentrations of sucrose, ammonium, nitrate and phosphate.

model_assumptions.text: The model assumes an irreversible progression in which active cells (active DM) are converted into dead cells (dead DM).
model_assumptions.quote: The model assumes an irreversible progression in which active cells (active DM) are converted into dead cells (dead DM) (Jacob et al., 2020) (Eq. 2).

model_assumptions.text: Perfect mixing and isothermal operation are implicit in the volume and concentration balances.
Negligible dilution of nutrients by feed is assumed in the Monod kinetic (phosphate uptake term omitted).

llm_proposal.name: improved unstructured model with sucrose hydrolysis
llm_proposal.description: A revised unstructured segregated model that adds hydrolysis of sucrose into fructose and glucose and uses an extended specific growth rate expression, applied to the same BY‑2 cell suspension bioreactor.

model_assumptions.text: The same assumptions as the initial model plus the addition that sucrose hydrolyzes to fructose and glucose according to the introduced stoichiometric terms.
